archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Goddess of Victory: NIKKE: October 25, 2026

entries.headline: Goddess of Victory: NIKKE announces three SSR characters for its fourth anniversary
entries.summary: The anniversary broadcast revealed Marian: Queen, Scarlet: Godslayer, and Rapunzel: Sanctuary. Marian enters Pick Up recruitment after maintenance on October 29, Scarlet follows on November 5, and Rapunzel can be obtained through the anniversary event and 14-day login rewards.
entries.verification: Two opened Japanese outlets independently reported the same official anniversary broadcast; dates and acquisition details are limited to what their evidence explicitly states.
entries.timeNote: The lead report was published at 7:55 p.m. Beijing time on October 24.

sourceLabels.label: 電ファミニコゲーマー News

entries.headline: Banana Life Sim launches on Steam, letting players quietly exist as a banana
entries.summary: Dynamic Games released the PC simulation game on October 24. Players spend time as a banana in a forest; it costs ¥140 normally and ¥98 through November 7.
entries.verification: Based on the opened Denfaminicogamer report; developer, platform, price, and premise remain media-reported facts.
entries.timeNote: Published at 10:11 p.m. Beijing time on October 24.

sourceLabels.label: 電ファミニコゲーマー News

entries.headline: Factorio 2.1 reaches stable release as Wube shifts to long-term support
entries.summary: The update improves quality-of-life features including mirrored placement and Space Age transport. Wube says this is the final major update, with bug fixes, platform support, mod tools, and prototypes for other games continuing.
entries.verification: The opened report explicitly relays Wube Software's update notes and development plans; no unopened first-party details were added.
entries.timeNote: Published at 4:25 p.m. Beijing time on October 24.

sourceLabels.label: 電ファミニコゲーマー News

entries.headline: Free browser horror game Rei, Tashitokimashita. launches with AI-made ghost photos
entries.summary: Players take jobs from a paranormal-photo fabrication center, instruct an AI where and how a ghost should appear, then distress the image with dates, scratches, and blur. It runs in PC and mobile browsers and has three endings.
entries.verification: The opened report includes the release description; platform, free access, mechanics, and ending count are limited to that evidence.
entries.timeNote: Published at 1:50 p.m. Beijing time on October 24.

sourceLabels.label: 電ファミニコゲーマー News

entries.headline: ASTRONEER studio lays off more than 30 staff after spin-off misses expectations
entries.summary: System Era Softworks confirmed more than 30 layoffs and said affected staff would receive severance and studio support. Marketing director Joe Tirado said STARSEEKER: Astroneer Expeditions reached hundreds of thousands of players but fell short of expectations.
entries.verification: Based on the opened AUTOMATON report relaying the studio statement and an identified executive's explanation.
entries.timeNote: Published at 1:41 p.m. Beijing time on October 24.

entries.headline: Analyst estimates 9.8 million ELDEN RING players have logged over 100 hours
entries.summary: Alinea Analytics analyst Rhys Elliott estimates about 9.8 million players have crossed 100 hours, around 3.5 million have earned every achievement or trophy, and roughly 2 million copies were sold in 2026.
entries.verification: All figures remain explicitly labeled as third-party estimates, not publisher-reported sales or platform telemetry.
entries.timeNote: Published at 5:20 p.m. Beijing time on October 24.

entries.headline: He's Just a Pixel Guy: How U.S. Players Experience Otome Games: Study comparing U.S. and Chinese otome players finds intimacy is not only about reciprocity
entries.summary: Syracuse University researchers surveyed U.S. otome players and compared the findings with earlier research on Chinese players. The paper reports that romantic intimacy with a character does not necessarily track the feeling that the character responds to the player.
entries.verification: The opened feature identifies the researchers, journal, population, and bounded conclusion; no causal claim was added.
entries.timeNote: The feature was published at 4:08 p.m. Beijing time on October 24; the paper appeared on October 8.
entries.regionLabel: Comparison of U.S. and Chinese players

entries.headline: 18 Summers spans 18 years across seven summers of lawn care and parenthood
entries.summary: FancyRancy's trailer presents a first-person lawn-mowing simulation in which a father tends the family backyard. Each completed summer advances time by three years, showing his son grow across seven summers. A Steam release is planned with no date announced.
entries.verification: The premise, structure, platform, and undated status come only from the opened report.
entries.timeNote: Published at 12:04 p.m. Beijing time on October 24; the trailer was posted on October 17.

entries.headline: Phantom Line: Prologue hands-on pits four-player tactical squads against anomalies
entries.summary: 4Gamer's development-build preview describes a survival-focused tactical shooter set in post-nuclear Europe, where corporate special forces can work in teams of up to four to contain paranormal threats.
entries.verification: Based on the opened hands-on report; its setting and co-op scale are not presented as final-build verdicts.
entries.timeNote: The hands-on report was published at 11:00 a.m. Beijing time on October 24.

entries.headline: Disney SparkLink Stars hands-on introduces the lighthearted Endelore team
entries.summary: 4Gamer previewed coly's new app, focusing on Beauty and the Beast-inspired character Rize and the Endelore team's story, interactions, and character-development experience.
entries.verification: The summary uses only the characters, team, and experience scope visible in the opened preview evidence.
entries.timeNote: Published at 4:00 p.m. Beijing time on October 24.

entries.headline: Zenless Zone Zero reveals Sunbringer gameplay ahead of version 3.4
entries.summary: HoYoverse released a Sunbringer combat video showing a three-character coordinated fighting style. The character is set to become playable in version 3.4, and the footage also shows Honkai: Star Rail collaboration character Robin.
entries.verification: The opened report directly relays the official gameplay video; character, version, and collaboration visuals remain within that evidence.
entries.timeNote: Published at 12:36 p.m. Beijing time on October 24.
